audience: chefs and kitchen managers who plan menus and food cost in Parsley

useCases.title: Find recipes that contain an allergen
useCases.text: The AI reads menu items with allergen flags and allergen text, and lists the recipes that contain nuts or other allergens.

useCases.title: Get nutrition facts and ingredients of a recipe
useCases.text: The AI opens a menu item and shows nutrition facts, ingredients, serving size and dietary characteristics.

useCases.title: See upcoming events and their menus
useCases.text: The AI lists events in a date window with type, time and menu, and opens an event for its line items and stations.

useCases.title: Check ingredient costing and suppliers
useCases.text: The AI lists ingredients and opens one for its supply options (supplier, SKU, pack size, cost) and unit conversions.

useCases.title: Record sales and waste on a cafe event
useCases.text: The AI records sold quantities, and waste and leftover quantities, per menu item on a cafe or hot bar event.

useCases.title: Create an event or set its covers
useCases.text: The AI creates an event with menu items, or sets the forecast or actual number of covers on an event.
